commitments.target: ensure smooth execution of the performance and special effects within the allotted time frame
commitments.detail: Technical lead will coordinate with all departments to ensure the performance and confetti drop are executed seamlessly.

commitments.target: secure necessary permissions for the use of copyrighted music
commitments.detail: Rights lead will confirm all necessary permissions for the use of the selected song and its excerpt.

commitments.target: coordinate with the band and performers for the in-person appearance
commitments.detail: Talent lead will work with the band and performers to ensure they are present and ready at the specified time.

commitments.target: ensure the safety of all participants during the confetti drop
commitments.detail: Safety lead will oversee the setup and execution of the confetti drop to prevent any accidents or injuries.
